mapper.select: SELECT s.SEM_ID AS semId, s.SEM_YEAR AS semYear, s.SEM_TERM AS semTerm FROM SEMESTERS s WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM LECTURE l JOIN LECTURE_CODE lc ON lc.LEC_CODE_ID = l.LEC_CODE_ID JOIN DEPARTMENT d ON d.DEPT_ID = lc.DEPT_ID WHERE l.SEM_ID = s.SEM_ID AND l.LEC_VAL_STATUS = 'OPEN' AND d.UNIV_ID = #{univId} ) ORDER BY s.SEM_STR_DATE ASC FETCH FIRST 1 ROW ONLY

SELECT l.LEC_ID AS lecId, lc.LEC_CODE AS courseCode, lc.LEC_COD_NAME AS courseName, pm.MEMBER_NAME AS professor, d.DEPT_NAME AS department, NVL(l.LEC_CREDIT, 0) AS lecCredit, l.LEC_SECTION AS lecSection, l.LEC_CAPACITY AS capacity, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM LECTURE_STUDENT_ENROLLMENT e WHERE e.LEC_ID = l.LEC_ID AND e.LEC_STD_ENR_STATUS != 'DRP') AS enrolledCount, (SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*) > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END FROM LECTURE_STUDENT_ENROLLMENT e2 WHERE e2.LEC_ID = l.LEC_ID AND e2.LMS_PRF_ID = #{lmsPrfId} AND e2.LEC_STD_ENR_STATUS != 'DRP') AS alreadyEnrolledFlag, t.LEC_TIM_DAY_CODE AS lecTimDayCode, TO_CHAR(t.LEC_TIM_STR_TIME, 'HH24:MI') AS lecTimStrTime, TO_CHAR(t.LEC_TIM_END_TIME, 'HH24:MI') AS lecTimEndTime FROM LECTURE l JOIN LECTURE_CODE lc ON lc.LEC_CODE_ID = l.LEC_CODE_ID JOIN DEPARTMENT d ON d.DEPT_ID = lc.DEPT_ID JOIN LMS_PROFILE pp ON pp.LMS_PRF_ID = l.LMS_PRF_ID JOIN MEMBER pm ON pm.MEMBER_ID = pp.MEMBER_ID LEFT JOIN LECTURE_TIME t ON t.LEC_ID = l.LEC_ID WHERE l.SEM_ID = #{semId} AND l.LEC_VAL_STATUS = 'OPEN' AND d.UNIV_ID = #{univId} ORDER BY l.LEC_ID, CASE t.LEC_TIM_DAY_CODE WHEN 'MON' THEN 1 WHEN 'TUE' THEN 2 WHEN 'WED' THEN 3 WHEN 'THU' THEN 4 WHEN 'FRI' THEN 5 WHEN 'SAT' THEN 6 WHEN 'SUN' THEN 7 ELSE 8 END, t.LEC_TIM_STR_TIME

SELECT l.LEC_ID AS lecId, l.SEM_ID AS semId, d.UNIV_ID AS univId, NVL(l.LEC_CREDIT, 0) AS lecCredit, l.LEC_CAPACITY AS capacity, l.LEC_VAL_STATUS AS lecValStatus, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM LECTURE_STUDENT_ENROLLMENT e WHERE e.LEC_ID = l.LEC_ID AND e.LEC_STD_ENR_STATUS != 'DRP') AS enrolledCount FROM LECTURE l JOIN LECTURE_CODE lc ON lc.LEC_CODE_ID = l.LEC_CODE_ID JOIN DEPARTMENT d ON d.DEPT_ID = lc.DEPT_ID WHERE l.LEC_ID = #{lecId}
SELECT 1 FROM LECTURE WHERE LEC_ID = #{lecId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT LEC_TIM_DAY_CODE AS dayCode, TO_CHAR(LEC_TIM_STR_TIME, 'HH24:MI') AS startTime, TO_CHAR(LEC_TIM_END_TIME, 'HH24:MI') AS endTime FROM LECTURE_TIME WHERE LEC_ID = #{lecId}

SELECT LEC_STD_ENR_ID AS lecStdEnrId, LEC_STD_ENR_STATUS AS status FROM LECTURE_STUDENT_ENROLLMENT WHERE LMS_PRF_ID = #{lmsPrfId} AND LEC_ID = #{lecId} ORDER BY LEC_STD_ENR_ID DESC FETCH FIRST 1 ROW ONLY

SELECT t.LEC_TIM_DAY_CODE AS dayCode, TO_CHAR(t.LEC_TIM_STR_TIME, 'HH24:MI') AS startTime, TO_CHAR(t.LEC_TIM_END_TIME, 'HH24:MI') AS endTime FROM LECTURE_STUDENT_ENROLLMENT e JOIN LECTURE l ON l.LEC_ID = e.LEC_ID JOIN LECTURE_TIME t ON t.LEC_ID = l.LEC_ID WHERE e.LMS_PRF_ID = #{lmsPrfId} AND l.SEM_ID = #{semId} AND e.LEC_STD_ENR_STATUS != 'DRP'
